purpose: Replacement full-hand comparison baseline after immutable v2 execution proved that exact Model A alone does not cover every postflop arena state. Model A remains authoritative wherever an exact node exists; unsupported Hero nodes use one shared deterministic legality-only closure in both benchmark arms.

runtime.decision_schema: model-a-continuation-decision/v1 when exact; legality-only benchmark closure otherwise
runtime.action_sampling: unchanged deterministic Model-A weighted sampling on exact nodes; deterministic closure only on unsupported exact nodes
runtime.sizing: unchanged exact-node empirical sizing when Model A supports the decision; support closure never raises

support_closure.rationale: The comparison targets the preflop policy difference. A common deterministic continuation closure prevents unequal missing-node treatment while retaining Model A on every exact supported node.

selection_provenance.preflop_model: Issue #101 retained the v5 production preflop model after the candidate failed its scientific gate.
selection_provenance.postflop_continuation: Issue #102 selected the persisted continuation overlay on VALIDATION with TEST unconsumed.
selection_provenance.support_closure: Added only after the first frozen #108 v2 execution failed on a missing exact postflop Model-A node before any environment report or strategy selection existed.

candidate_comparison.candidate_exact_context_rule: Use a #107 calculated decision only when its canonical preflop context and hand class match exactly.
candidate_comparison.candidate_out_of_support_rule: Fall back to this frozen support-closed reference policy and record the decision as out-of-support; never invent or nearest-neighbor a calculated Hero range.
candidate_comparison.postflop_rule: Reference and candidate use separate instances of this identical support-closed continuation after the preflop street, so missing exact nodes receive the same deterministic treatment contract.

interpretation_limits: This is a benchmark reference, not the promoted v83 production preflop strategy and not an optimal Hero strategy.
Support-closure decisions are not learned poker recommendations; their frequency must be reported with every environment result.
The candidate-minus-reference result is conditional on this explicit continuation closure and the certified Zoom population.
A high closure rate weakens external validity and must be disclosed rather than hidden or replaced by nearest-context matching.
